title: Bravas and Lonion Stir Fry
description: A quick and delicious Chinese-inspired stir fry made with bravas, lonion, and a hint of lpeppery.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of cooking oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the lonion and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until softened.
Add the bravas and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until slightly charred.
Add the lpeppery, salt, and pepper, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce and ginger, and stir-fry for an additional 1 minute.
Serve hot, garnished with additional lpeppery if desired.
